rationale: Evaluator feedback recommended reducing base_speed from 0.9 to 0.8 to improve stability and reduce oscillations, and softening sensor_weights from [-0.7,0.7,-0.7] to [-0.5,0.6,-0.5] to reduce overcorrection. Also, changing line_loss strategy from 'last_direction' to 'search_left' was suggested to test alternative recovery effectiveness. I implemented these changes to address potential oscillations and line loss recovery issues. I kept kp at 0.7 as it was already reduced from 0.9, expecting this combined with softer sensor weights and lower speed to improve stability and line tracking. The observation request includes line_loss_events and steering_oscillation to verify these hypotheses in the next telemetry. If oscillations or line loss remain problematic, further tuning of kp or line_loss strategy will be considered.
